record.label: Inner alias loading and SELECT savings per step
record.statement: Inner state preparation represents the selected square in a 126-qubit one-hot register and the inner index in five binary qubits. Appendix I.3 gives 390 T gates per alias-sampling lookup at the workspace width used in Table S3.
record.boundary: The rotations and angles save $37{,}688-23{,}636=14{,}052$ $T$ gates. Inner state preparation saves $5{,}888-2{,}264=3{,}624$. Together these are 17,676 of the 18,398 $T$ gates saved per step in the table, or 96.1%. Reflections and phase-estimation control are accounted for separately.
